name: Eyes of the Sentinels

angles.text: The Sentinels are the night elves' traditional standing army and guardians. They join martial skill with Elune's blessings and watchful eyes.
Guarding Darnassus protects the night elves' capital and strengthens the Alliance's main stronghold in northern Kalimdor.
Scout owls reflect the night elves' traditional skill at reconnaissance. Trained beasts and celestial avian watchers extend a huntress's senses.
Weapons alone cannot protect the kaldorei. Regular prayer and Elune's spiritual gifts are vital to the Sentinels' guardianship.

aliases: what is eyes of the sentinels
faq.answer: Sentinel Dalia Sunblade directs the placing of sentinel owls at key points around Darnassus. Their watch helps the Sentinels guard the city against looming threats.
faq.q: What is Eyes of the Sentinels?

faq.answer: Sentinel Dalia Sunblade is a kaldorei guardian at the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus. She oversees local defenses and sees that watchful owls guard key thoroughfares.
The sentinel owls watch over Darnassus as aerial lookouts and divine scouts granted by Elune. They survey key gathering places and transit chokepoints.
faq.q: Why are Sentinel Owls being placed around Darnassus?

faq.answer: The sentinel owls are posted at the northern entrance to the depths beneath Cenarion Hold, the Darnassus Bank in the town center, the inn at Craftsman's Terrace, and the city gates.
faq.q: Where are the Sentinel Owls placed?

faq.answer: Sentinel Dalia Sunblade says something feels amiss across Teldrassil, the World Tree. So the Sentinels increase their watch and stay ready for unseen dangers.
faq.q: Why are the Sentinels on high alert in Teldrassil?

faq.answer: General Shandris Feathermoon commands the Sentinels and sees that her huntresses balance martial duties with daily devotion and prayer to Elune.
faq.q: What role does General Feathermoon have in the Sentinels' daily duties?

sections.body: At the Temple of the Moon, Sentinel Dalia Sunblade watches over Darnassus. General Shandris Feathermoon has decreed that every warrior must balance skill in battle with devotion to Elune. So Dalia arranges for sentinel owls to watch key places in the city. Their daily duties leave the Sentinels time for prayer and reflection before the Moon Goddess, while Darnassus remains guarded.
sections.title: Devotion and Defense

sections.body: Unease spreads across Teldrassil, and the Sentinels grow more watchful. Sentinel owls take posts at the northern entrance to the depths beneath Cenarion Hold, the bank in the town square, the inn in Craftsman's Terrace, and the main city gates. Local city guards help place them. From these posts, the owls watch over those who walk the streets of the Great Tree.
sections.title: Watch Over Darnassus

summary: In Darnassus, Sentinel Dalia Sunblade sets owls to watch as unease grows across Teldrassil. Their posts guard the city and leave the Sentinels time to pray to Elune.
attribution: In-game quest text: Eyes of the Sentinels
